prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI video ad maker for everyone — the right choice depends on what you’re trying to achieve (platform, scale, creative style, budget). Below are top options by use case, with quick pros/cons and when to pick each. If you tell me your platform (TikTok/Meta/YouTube), budget, and whether you need AI presenters or repurposing, I’ll recommend 2–3 specific tools.

Top picks by use case

- AI presenters / script-to-video with avatars
  - Synthesia — polished, multilingual AI avatars; great for product explainer ads, tutorials, and localized ads at scale.
  - HeyGen — similar to Synthesia, often more affordable; fast for short social ads with an on-camera presenter.
  - When to choose: you want a realistic presenter without filming.

- Repurposing long-form content to short ads
  - Pictory — converts blogs/webinars to short clips with captions, good for social.
  - Opus Clip — automatically generates short vertical clips and hooks from long videos (TikTok/Reels).
  - When to choose: you have existing webinars/long videos to turn into ad creative fast.

- Template-driven social ad makers (easy, fast)
  - Canva — huge template library, brand kit, simple video editor, good free tier.
  - InVideo — ad templates, easy editing, automated scene creation from text.
  - Promo.com / Shakr — built specifically for social/video ad templates and e‑commerce.
  - When to choose: you want fast, template-based ad creation with minimal learning curve.

- Advanced creative/AI editing and generative effects
  - Runway — powerful generative tools, inpainting and advanced edits; more for high-end or experimental ads.
  - VEED/CapCut — strong automated captioning, auto-subtitles, and editing for short-form ads.
  - When to choose: you need creative visual effects or advanced editing tools.

- Enterprise-scale creative + analytics
  - VidMob — combines creative production with performance analytics and optimization at scale.
  - When to choose: you run many campaigns, need creative testing and data-driven optimization.

How to choose (quick checklist)
- Target platform/aspect ratios (vertical for TikTok, Reels; landscape for YouTube).
- Need for human-like presenters or custom voices?
- Volume and scale: single ad vs. hundreds of personalized videos.
- Brand kit & templates (logos, fonts, colors).
- Stock assets, music library, and licensing rights.
- Integrations (ad platforms, Shopify, analytics).
- Budget (one-off vs. subscription; per-video pricing).
- Turnaround time and learning curve.

Recommendation if you want a 1-minute answer
- For most marketers making social ads quickly: Canva or InVideo.
- For AI presenters/localized explainer ads: Synthesia or HeyGen.
- For repurposing long content into many short ads: Pictory or Opus Clip.
- For enterprise testing and optimization: VidMob.

If you tell me: platform (TikTok/Meta/YouTube), whether you need an on-screen presenter, your monthly budget, and how many videos you need per month, I’ll recommend the best 2–3 choices and a sample workflow.
